SELECT
FROM sensor_slave_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM sensor_slave_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND online = 1 ORDER BY address ASC

SELECT
FROM sensor_slave_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND online = 0 ORDER BY address ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_slaves, SUM(CASE WHEN online = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as online_count, SUM(CASE WHEN online = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as offline_count, AVG(count) as avg_count, MAX(count) as max_count, MIN(count) as min_count FROM sensor_slave_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)

SELECT
FROM sensor_slave_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) ORDER BY timestamp DESC

SELECT t1.* FROM sensor_slave_data t1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT device_id, MAX(timestamp) as max_timestamp FROM sensor_slave_data GROUP BY device_id ) t2 ON t1.device_id = t2.device_id AND t1.timestamp = t2.max_timestamp ORDER BY t1.device_id, t1.address
